packet.question: Under Amazon's FY2023 10-K revenue policy, when is unearned revenue recorded and when is it recognized as revenue?

answer.answer:
Amazon records unearned revenue when payments are received before the service is performed.
Amazon recognizes that revenue over time.

claims.text: Amazon records unearned revenue when payments are received before the service is performed.
Amazon recognizes that revenue over time.

requirements.requirement: Payments received before service obligations are performed trigger recording of unearned revenue.
Payments due before service obligations are performed also trigger recording of unearned revenue; receipt is not the only trigger.
Unearned revenue is recognized as revenue over the service period, not all immediately on receipt.
